about: funk: a dry, tight live kit locked on the one with ghost notes and busy 8th/16th hats, a syncopated finger bass that leads, clavinet stabbing dominant-9th vamps like a rhythm guitar, short brass-section stabs on top; 95-115 BPM, dry and in the pocket
master: dry, warm and analog: little reverb, punchy drums and bass up front, no lofi roll-off and no heavy limiting
